input:
An object is moving in the clockwise direction around the unit circle x^2 + y^2 = 1. As it passes through the point (1/2, sqrt(3)/2), its y-coordinate is decreasing at the rate of 3 units per sec. The rate at which the x-coordinate changes at this point is

Options:
A. 2 units/sec
B. 3sqrt(3) units/sec
C. sqrt(3) units/sec
D. 2sqrt(3) units/sec

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Use related rates on x^2+y^2=1 to find dx/dt at a given point, given dy/dt.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Differentiate the circle equation with respect to time.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Differentiate implicitly, substitute x, y, dy/dt, then simplify.
logical_steps: Step 3: Substitute point values and dy/dt

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Substitution in related-rate formula gives positive 3sqrt(3), consistent with clockwise motion at this point.
